scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind finding keyboard keys.
Space bar: leaves a gap between words. Enter key: moves to the next line or confirms a choice.
Backspace: deletes the character before the cursor. Shift key: makes capital letters when held. Number keys: type the digits zero to nine.
With an adult supervising, practise space bar and enter key using a computer if one is available. Without a computer, draw the screen and explain each step to a partner.
